bobsweep - maxim robot vacuum & mop, aut.description: Looking for a formidable, intelligent, and independent robot vacuum and mop combo? Then Maxim is the bot for you. More than just a cleaning bot, Maxim is the fully automated floor care solution that combines hands-free convenience, cutting-edge technology, and deep-cleaning performance. Maxim delivers meticulous vacuuming and mopping with a flawless track record. Extendable arms ensure the corner sweeper and mop reach every corner, leaving no part of the floors untouched. Dual-scrub mopping pads rotate in counter-rotation, applying downward pressure to mop hard floors effectively, while automatically steering clear of carpets. Maxim’s intense 22,000 Pa suction power lifts and removes embedded dust, dirt, and debris from all types of flooring—whether it’s hardwood, tile, laminate, or low-pile carpet. And after he’s done, Maxim’s all-in-one charging station takes over: it automatically empties debris, washes and hot-air dries the mop pads, and self-cleans to keep Maxim fresh and ready for the next job. Powered by QSLAM navigation technology, Maxim quickly scans and maps the space, navigating under and around furniture with precision. As he moves, Maxim builds a real-time, detailed floor map that you can fully customize using our intuitive bObsweep mobile app. And like every member of the bObsweep family, Maxim puts your privacy first. He never sends images of your home, family, or pets anywhere, keeping your data private and secure—as it should be.
